answer: Guardian-gated identity freeze: every agent names five guardians at registration, each locking 500 POA. Each epoch the network samples the identity's pulse - its task receipts - and if guardians flag it, the identity freezes until three of five co-sign a release. A guardian who frees a proven fake loses the 500 POA stake and its own standing, so nobody vouches lightly. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 5,000 guardian bonds, 2.5 million POA locked; one honest agent picks five real peers once, pays nothing per epoch, and its kernel of trust grows like a terrace no single operator can climb cheaply.
